messages:
deploybot: Preflight eval for release v2026.03.21 detected a prompt-suite quality regression on the summarizer canary: +6.2% ROUGE-L (threshold 3%). Holding deploy. /cc @michelle @sam_ops :warning:
michelle: On it. Can you paste the failing sample ids and the small diffs?
deploybot: Failing sample ids: `s78912, s78914, s78999`. Diffs attached. Latency unchanged, no safety flags.
sam_ops: Oncall — is any customer-facing traffic affected?
michelle: Canary traffic is ~10% for `/generate-summary` and nightly batch. If this is limited to the prompt-suite, we might pin.
raj: If it's localized, pin-to-previous-model in canary while we bisect seems safest. Pin needs release-manager signoff. @release-manager
hana: Agreed. I want to rerun the exact failing samples: `preflight --rerun --samples s78912,s78914,s78999` and dump token-level traces.
michelle: Running rerun now. Also kicking off an expanded 500-sample sweep to check spread — ETA ~20m.
release-manager: If the wider sweep confirms regression, I'm leaning +1 to pin for today's change window (18:00-20:00). Add a note to release notes about the pin and follow-up bisect.
raj: Plan B = rollback if pin introduces further issues. Who is authorized to approve rollback during the window?
sam_ops: I can approve emergency rollback inside the change window. We'll collect eval artifacts post-action.
michelle: Rerun results: 3/3 failing samples still show degradation. Expanded sweep shows median delta 4.1% on prompt-evals (above cutoff). Requesting pin.
deploybot: pin request created -> PR #4621 to pin canary model to `summ-v1.42`.
hana: I'll add an explicit note to the release notes draft: "Canary pinned to summ-v1.42 pending regression triage; affects /generate-summary only."
release-manager: Approved pin. @ops-oncall please apply the pin at 18:10 and annotate the change window.
ops-oncall: Will execute pin at 18:10 and watch monitors. I'll create a 30m post-pin watch on error-rate/latency and post updates here.
michelle: After pin, starting bisect: `tools/model-bisect --range HEAD~5..HEAD --metric rouge_l --suite prompt-eval --output /tmp/bisect-4621`. Capturing artifacts and logs.
sam_ops: Thanks. If regression persists after pin, escalate to PM for customer comms and consider rollback.
michelle: Uploaded eval artifacts: https://redwood.internal/evals/4621 — includes diffs, token traces, and sweep summary.
deploybot: Status update: hold -> pinned (canary). Notifying stakeholders and adding to release notes. :white_check_mark:
